title: TD.IND.02 Shared-link openings that were authorised
description: Of the requests to open a family member's shared link, the proportion the home country released.
name: TrustDemoIND02
guidance: A definition only: it states no target and no value. Data elements: VHLPayload.exp Expires at; VHLPayload.flag Flags; VHLPayload.url Manifest URL. Decision tables: TD.DT.05. Requirements: STD-ACC-001. The populations are described, not computable: this guide carries no CQL.

population.description: Manifest requests in the reporting period, released or refused.

criteria.expression: COUNT of manifest-request AuditEvent (TrustDemoOnesaVhlAccess) WHERE AuditEvent.recorded is in the reporting period

population.description: Manifest requests in the reporting period that were released.

criteria.expression: COUNT of manifest-request AuditEvent (TrustDemoOnesaVhlAccess) WHERE AuditEvent.recorded is in the reporting period AND AuditEvent.outcome is success

stratifier.description: the receiver abroad, and its country
